posts.label: Carousel 1

slides.title: Things nobody told you about your twenties
slides.body: The stuff they left out of the guidebook.

slides.title: It's okay to be in a chapter with no name
slides.body: Not every phase of life has a clear label. The in-between is a real place, not a failure.

slides.title: You can just call HR
slides.body: If you don't know what your benefits cover, ask. That's literally their job.

slides.title: Missing someone and knowing you made the right call can both be true
slides.body: You don't have to be over it to know the decision was right.

slides.title: Silence in a friendship doesn't have to mean the end
slides.body: Sometimes people go quiet because they're in their own storm. Following up is never too late.

slides.title: The 'five-year plan' is a direction, not a contract
slides.body: Your future self reserves the right to want entirely different things. That's not failure, it's information.
